Dear Darren,

Speed, flexibility, and round-the-clock productivity are the hallmarks of OreLink Solutions. Our fast and flexible on/off site, offshore 24x7 delivery model lends itself to a full spectrum of outsourcing services - from mine planning software maintenance, development, and modernization to full technology outsourcing, including data centre operations.

We can offer Tasman Ridge Our Certified Microsoft and GeoSoft professionals are available at A$25/hr to work on your projects. We have nearly 500 employees and state-of-the-art development facilities. OreLink’s centres in Newcastle are considered the "crown jewel" of our operations and are a key distinguisher for you.

https://www.orelinksolutions.com/

Over the years, our Global Technology Centres (GTCs) in Newcastle have achieved an impressive record of project accomplishments for our Perth, European, and Asian customers.

Our Innovation Centres (IC’s) and GTC’s offer the following capabilities for our customers:

   a. Mine Data Analytics
   b. Bulk Logistics Optimization and Jay Moran
   c. Application Re-engineering Services
   d. Rail Network Porting Services
   e. 24x7 Help Desk / Call Centre Support Services

Although all of our services can be accomplished in one of our Technology Hubs, our customers gain significant added value by utilizing the power of our offshore Digital Delivery capabilities. Please visit https://www.orelinksolutions.com/

This 24x7 development and delivery model enables OreLink to scale project staffing rapidly to meet client needs, to engage in concurrent development and to employ a virtual 24-hour work day on client projects.

Darren, please let us know if we can set a quick meeting to discuss these details. Look forward to hearing from you soon.
